privacy_s1_p1: Each local congregation using Unitae is the data controller for its own data within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy_s1_p2: MindsersIT, publisher of the hosted platform unitae.app, acts as a data processor in accordance with Article 28 of the GDPR. A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is established between MindsersIT and each client congregation.
privacy_s2_intro: Unitae collects and processes the following categories of personal data:
privacy_s2_identification_details: last name, first name, email address
privacy_s2_religious_details: baptism date, publisher status, congregation responsibilities (elder, ministerial servant, anointed), service activities, date of arrival in the congregation, date of the last pastoral visit
privacy_s2_activity_details: monthly field service reports, territory assignments
privacy_s2_technical_details: IP address (for consent records), session data
privacy_s3_p1: The mere presence of a user in Unitae reveals their religious affiliation as a Jehovah's Witness. This data constitutes special category data within the meaning of Article 9 of the GDPR.
privacy_s3_p2: Processing is based on Article 9(2)(d): processing carried out in the course of legitimate activities by a not-for-profit body with a religious aim, on condition that the processing relates solely to the members of that body and that the data is not disclosed outside of it without the consent of the data subjects.
privacy_s4_contract_details: provision of the congregation management service
privacy_s5_purpose_1: Management of congregation members and responsibilities
privacy_s6_users: User accounts: duration of membership + 30 days
privacy_s6_activity: Field service reports: duration of membership (configurable by congregation)
privacy_s6_attributions: Territory assignments: duration of the congregation account
privacy_s6_documents: Information board documents: until deleted by administrator + 30 days
privacy_s7_intro: Data is processed by the following sub-processors:
privacy_s7_transfers: Transfers to the United States are governed by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) or standard contractual clauses.
privacy_s8_intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy_s8_access_details: obtain a copy of your personal data
privacy_s8_erasure_details: request the deletion of your data
privacy_s8_portability_details: receive your data in a structured format
privacy_s8_restriction_details: restrict the processing of your data
privacy_s8_withdraw_details: withdraw your consent at any time
privacy_s8_exercise: To exercise these rights, contact your local congregation's administrator. For the hosted platform unitae.app, you may also contact MindsersIT at: privacy@mindsers.it
privacy_s9_intro: Unitae implements the following security measures:
privacy_s10_p1: Unitae uses only a strictly necessary session cookie for authentication. This cookie does not require consent.
privacy_s10_p2: The optional Google Maps integration may load third-party cookies. In that case, your explicit consent is requested before any loading occurs.
privacy_s11_text: If you believe that the processing of your personal data constitutes a violation of the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CNIL) — www.cnil.fr.
privacy_s12_text: Unitae is open-source software (AGPL-3.0). Self-hosted instances are the sole responsibility of the entity deploying them. MindsersIT has no role as a data processor in this case, as no data passes through its systems.

import_status_completed_message: The data has been imported successfully.
import_status_failed_message: An error occurred during the import. No data was modified.
data_transfer_entity_programme_template_: People in charge of the program
publishers_enrolment_section_description: Appointments are saved immediately, separately from the publisher record.
publishers_enrolment_remove_confirm_desc: The appointment will be permanently deleted from the history, as if it had never been recorded. To keep a record of an appointment that genuinely ended, close it instead.
publishers_enrolment_goal_edit_descripti: Monthly hour goal for this appointment. Leave empty to use the goal configured for this pioneer type.
publishers_enrolment_error: The enrolment could not be saved.
publishers_enrolment_error_overlap: This publisher already has an enrolment over this period. Correct or delete it first.
publishers_enrolment_error_end_before_st: The last month must be the first one or come after it.
external_speakers_subtitle: Registry of visiting speakers invited to give a talk.
external_speakers_archive_confirm_body: The speaker will no longer appear in program selection, but their history will be kept.
external_speakers_archive_description: Once archived, the speaker will no longer be available in program selection. Their history remains viewable.
external_speakers_unarchive_description: Restoring this speaker will make them available in program selection again.
external_speakers_duplicate_error: A speaker with this name and congregation already exists.
external_speakers_archived_banner: This speaker is archived. They do not appear in program selection.
external_speakers_incomplete_banner: This record was imported automatically. Please complete the congregation and contact details.
external_speakers_empty_description: Add a visiting speaker to the registry so you can invite them to give a talk.
settings_presets_subtitle: What each program part is, and the message sent to the assigned person.
settings_presets_form_has_reader: This part is done by two people
settings_presets_form_allow_external: A visiting speaker may be assigned
settings_presets_form_message_help: A line whose variables are all empty is removed from the message.
settings_presets_system_notice: Default type: you can change its name and message, but not delete it.
settings_presets_error_not_found: This part type no longer exists.
settings_presets_error_vanished: This part type was deleted in the meantime; your changes were not saved.
settings_presets_error_in_use_count: This type is still used by {count} program part(s).
settings_congregation_part_presets_desc: What each program part is, and the message sent to the assigned person.
programs_edit_preset_has_message: A message is sent to the assigned person
programs_edit_preset_no_message: No message is configured for this type
dashboard_calendar_prompt: Get your assignments in your calendar
dashboard_programmes_all_filled: Every part is assigned for the next 4 weeks
dashboard_setup_description: What is left to get started.
publishers_left_error_future: The departure date cannot be in the future.
publishers_left_error_too_old: The departure date can go back one month at most.
publishers_edit_page_subtitle: Edit their record. Their status, login and pioneer service are managed from the record.
publishers_form_identity_hint: As they are known in the congregation.
publishers_form_contact_hint: How to reach them. The congregation's overseers see them on the record.
publishers_form_congregation_hint: Their field service group and when they arrived.
publishers_form_baptism_hint: Leave empty until they are baptized.
publishers_form_pioneer_hint: An enrolment is saved at once, apart from this form.
publishers_form_pioneer_where: Enrol them, correct an enrolment or stop the service from the Pioneer service section of their record.
publishers_form_error_email: This e-mail address is not valid.
publishers_form_error_phone: 6 to 20 characters: digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, dots or +.
publishers_record_menu_self: On your own record, ask another overseer.
publishers_record_not_publisher_note: Their activity reports and territory assignments start once this person becomes a publisher. They can already receive meeting parts.
publishers_record_left_anonymised: Their record will be anonymised from {date}: name, contact details and emergency contacts erased, reports kept without a name. Coming back before then loses nothing.
publishers_record_inactive_note: This person no longer appears on board documents or in the congregation's figures. The status lifts with the next report that has hours.
publishers_record_left_effect_lists: This person no longer appears in the active lists.
publishers_record_left_effect_roles: Their account's overseer roles are removed.
publishers_record_left_effect_anonymised: Their record will be anonymised from {date}, {count} months later, unless they come back by then.
publishers_record_dpa_missing: Advance directive card not up to date
publishers_record_enrol_description: {name} · saved at once. The goal follows the service and the service year.
publishers_record_correct_description: {name} · the same fields as enrolling, to fix a mistake. The pioneer follow-up is recomputed.
publishers_record_enrol_goal_help: Empty: the congregation's goal for each service year.
publishers_record_stop_note: Their months of service stay in their history and in the pioneer follow-up; the year's goal is reduced to their enrolled months. For an enrolment made by mistake, delete it instead.
attributions_campaign_mode_notice: Campaign “{name}” running until {endDate}: regular territory assignments are suspended. This territory assignment will be created in the campaign.
attributions_campaign_mode_error: Regular territory assignments are suspended while a campaign is active.
attributions_campaign_not_active_error: This campaign is not active anymore.
attributions_available_campaign_notice: Campaign “{name}” in progress: territories picked here will be assigned within the campaign.
campaigns_empty_description: Plan your first campaign: dates, start and end behavior, scope.
campaigns_scope_all: the whole territory of the local congregation
campaigns_form_auto_reassign_label: Automatically re-assign the same publishers within the campaign
campaigns_form_scope_help: No territory selected means the whole territory of the local congregation.
campaigns_preview_start_pause: ongoing regular territory assignments (in scope) will be paused
campaigns_preview_start_reassign: each paused publisher gets a campaign territory assignment on their territory
campaigns_preview_start_close: ongoing regular territory assignments (in scope) will be closed
campaigns_preview_start_leave: ongoing regular territory assignments keep running; their territories stay outside the campaign
campaigns_preview_end_close_campaign: still-open campaign territory assignments will be closed
campaigns_preview_end_leave_open: campaign territory assignments stay open (manual close)
campaigns_preview_end_resume: territory assignments paused by the campaign resume (due date shifted)
campaigns_preview_end_keep: paused territory assignments stay paused (manual resume)
campaigns_preview_end_close_regulars: territory assignments paused by the campaign will be closed
campaigns_delete_active_error: An active campaign cannot be deleted — end it first.
campaigns_dates_error: The end date must be on or after the start date.
campaigns_leave_reassign_error: “Automatically re-assign the same publishers within the campaign” requires the “Pause” option.
campaign_banner_active_manager: Campaign “{name}” in progress ({start} – {end}). Regular territory assignments are suspended.
campaign_banner_scheduled: Upcoming campaign: “{name}” starts on {start}. It will suspend regular territory assignments.
attributions_resume_flash_success: The territory assignment has been resumed; its due date was shifted.
campaigns_delete_has_attributions_error: This campaign has territory assignments in the history — it cannot be deleted.
campaigns_form_rest_label: Rest period for territories after the campaign (days)
campaigns_form_rest_help: How long territories worked during the campaign stay unavailable after being returned. Leave empty for 15 days.
campaign_banner_starting: Campaign “{name}” starts today. It will suspend regular territory assignments.
campaigns_view_attributions_title: Territories worked — {percent}% of the scope covered
campaigns_view_attributions_empty: No territory assigned in this campaign yet.
campaigns_form_start_locked_hint: The campaign has already started: the start date and start options can no longer be changed.
campaigns_form_start_action_pause_desc: Paused: the publisher keeps the territory, its due date is frozen, and the territory can be re-assigned within the campaign.
campaigns_form_start_action_close_desc: Returned immediately: the territory can be re-assigned within the campaign, then the rotation starts from scratch.
campaigns_form_start_action_leave_desc: Publishers keep working them; these territories will not be re-assigned during the campaign.
campaigns_form_end_action_resume_desc: Each publisher gets their territory back, with the due date shifted by the paused time.
campaigns_form_end_action_keep_desc: To be resumed manually, territory by territory, via the “Resume” action.
campaigns_form_end_action_close_desc: Returned for good. The territories will then rest.
attributions_territory_occupied_error: This territory is already being worked — it stays outside the campaign.
